text: Security is a vital part of web development that every developer should take seriously. First, websites should always use HTTPS to protect data sent between users and servers. Second, strong authentication, such as complex passwords and two-factor verification, helps confirm that users are who they claim to be. Third, input validation is essential because it stops harmful data from entering the system. Developers must also understand common vulnerabilities, including SQL injection, cross-site scripting, and broken access control. By following these basic security practices, developers can build safer websites and protect users from attacks.
